effect.unusualend.breach_linked.descript: Teleports the player back to where he received this effect for the first time when the effect runs out.
effect.unusualend.crystallization.descri: Cancel all damages. Returns all canceled damage when the effect runs out.
effect.unusualend.disruption.description: Negates your Block Reach distance, making you unable to break, interact with or place blocks.
effect.unusualend.ender_infection.descri: Teleports randomly for a short period. Produce an Endermite when the effect runs out.
effect.unusualend.heaviness.description: Decreases jump height and walking speed; higher levels make the user slower and heavier.
effect.unusualend.serenity.description: Automatically protects from various dangers, at the cost of dividing the potion duration per half the remaining time for each use (Cancel fall damages, remove some negative effects, feed when starving, etc).
effect.unusualend.spectral_stride.descri: Increases walking speed and decreases gravity; higher levels make the user faster and lighter.
effect.unusualend.warped_tenacity.descri: Provides various buffs, making you more resistant; Higher levels increases the strenght of buffs, at the cost of debuffs (nausea, mining fatigue, etc).
enchantment.unusualend.benevolence.desc: Regenerate targets instead of stealing their health. Create a regeneration cloud when hitting the ground
enchantment.unusualend.boloks_fury.desc: Deal additional damages if the target is at full health or above its default max health
enchantment.unusualend.boloks_head.desc: Reduce damages received when hitting a wall (riptide, elytra). Doesn't affect fall damages
enchantment.unusualend.boloks_wings.desc: Deals damages to nearby entities when flying fast enough in elytras
enchantment.unusualend.bonding.desc: Heal your nearby pets when successfully hitting an entity
enchantment.unusualend.everlasting.desc: Causes the item to never naturally despawn
enchantment.unusualend.joust.desc: Grant Strength and Swift Strikes while riding an entity (like a horse). The potion level scale with the enchantment level
jei.unusualend.jei_desc_1:
Using multiple orbs (even from different types) don't make their probability to activate more likely. It'll instead apply all the effects to the targeted entities.
Orbs will only damage nearby monsters. Animals won't be affected.
jei.unusualend.jei_desc_10:
Touching a Warped Bubble will pop it and push the player in the direction he's looking at.
Using Warped Boots will cancel this effect, and instead allow the player to stand on the block.
jei.unusualend.jei_desc_11: Using a Warped Potion on a Carved Warped Squash will summon a Glub.
jei.unusualend.jei_desc_12: The Crystal Catalyst texture will change if renamed with "Beacon", "Infuser" or "Conduit" in its name, to make each version easier to distinguish if needed. This change is purely visual, and won't affect its functionnality.
jei.unusualend.jei_desc_13:
Damaging an entity will heal you. 
Targets affected by potion effects such as Regeneration or Health Boost will grant you a better Regeneration effect for a longer duration.
jei.unusualend.jei_desc_14: The Totem of the Void will trigger from anywhere in the inventory.
jei.unusualend.jei_desc_15:
The Building Inhibitor allow players to get a primitive version of claim / anti-grief in their survival world.
The player placing a Building Inhibitor is immuned to its effect nor will trigger the device.
jei.unusualend.jei_desc_16:
Placed under Gloopslate or Gloopstone blocks.
Grows faster at 120+ blocks of altitude. Can't be bonemealed under this height.
jei.unusualend.jei_desc_18: Enderblob Moults can be obtained by using a Brush on an Enderblob.
jei.unusualend.jei_desc_19: Traded by specific Wandering Traders, found in the End.
jei.unusualend.jei_desc_2: The Golem Altar is activated using a Dragon Breath bottle, to summon the Endstone Golem.
jei.unusualend.jei_desc_21: Some items can be linked to a Teleportation Anchor, teleporting to its location when triggered.
jei.unusualend.jei_desc_22: This block will only be solid to players , making every other entity able to walk through it.
jei.unusualend.jei_desc_23:
Warped Chests can be, like Vaults, opened by multiple players.
Some items, like Warped Anchor or Warped Infusion will only be found in Warped Chests.
jei.unusualend.jei_desc_24: Can't capture monsters and entities with a too large volume (Height + Width > 3 blocks)
jei.unusualend.jei_desc_26:
Produce Soul Flames when placed on Soul Sand or Soul Soil.
Produce Pink Flames when placed on Gloopstone or Gloopslate.
jei.unusualend.jei_desc_27:
Gloopslate will slowly turn End Stone below it into Gloopy End Stone.
Gloopslate will slowly turn Gloopy End Stone above it into Gloopslate.
jei.unusualend.jei_desc_3: Chorus Petals are obtained by using shears on a Chorus Flower or Chorus Cane Flower.
jei.unusualend.jei_desc_4: Can be produced by Ender Fireflies, when eating an Enderblob.
jei.unusualend.jei_desc_5:
Grants you advanced Invisibility (allowing you to see yourself in third person, and not emitting particles) and Spectral Stride (making you lighter and faster).
Enderling Cloth won't hide your armor.
jei.unusualend.jei_desc_6:
Grants you Spectral Stride when sprinting, which makes you lighter (lower gravity) and faster.
Crouching while wearing it will pacify nearby Undead Enderlings
jei.unusualend.jei_desc_7: This block will be solid to all entities, except players that will be able to walk through it.
jei.unusualend.jei_desc_8: Warped Berries are used to feed and attract Glubs.
jei.unusualend.jei_desc_9: End Blob is used to tame Ender Fireflies.
